notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's and Eternal Witness' power.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix enter the battlefield, triggering themselves and Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
